checks.name: a16-determinism-where-possible-and-honesty-where-not
checks.summary: No fixed sleep, no wall-clock timer and no goroutine was ADDED by this task. The A8 kernel read was deliberately placed inside the window I5_I6_crash_resume already holds open between findChildPID returning and the SIGKILL, precisely so that no new concurrency was needed to read a running child's state; that is why the confined mechanism could not be proved the same way, since proving it would have required a new goroutine to read /proc while Run blocked, and a16 forbids adding one. The two A8 phases added to I2 are ordinary synchronous subtests. Every clock stays injected: both phases advance fx.clock, the mutableClock, exactly as every other phase does, and neither reads time.Now. Every wait remains a bounded deadline poll reusing an idiom already in internal/runner (findChildPID and waitUntilProcessGone). No duration is asserted as a threshold anywhere: all measured durations -- the 54.16 s whole-run figure, the per-subtest figures, and the ledger's duration_api_ms and duration_ms -- are recorded as OBSERVATIONS. Under gate rule G7 a skipped subtest would never have been a pass; none was skipped, so this record's status is not skipped.
